2_Introduction: The device achieves a notably enhanced PCE of 21.4128%, corresponding to a JSC of 24.572 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.1232 V, and an FF of 77.5874%.  The perovskite (Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0) solution was prepared with a concentration of 1.73 mol/L in mixed solvent of DMF and DMSO. The perovskite solutions were spin-coated onto the substrate at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 40 s. During the spin-coating process, 160 µL of CB antisolvent was quickly dripped onto the centre of the perovskite film 10 s before the end of the process. The films were then annealed on a hot plate at 110 °C for 25 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The high-performance perovskite solar cell arises from a tightly coupled interplay between compositional design, kinetic crystallization control, and intrinsic defect suppression—despite the absence of exogenous SAMs, additives, or passivators in the reported protocol, the Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃.₀ formulation inherently leverages A-site cation entropy to stabilize the photoactive α-phase while suppressing halide vacancy formation and ion migration, as evidenced by the near-ideal Goldschmidt tolerance factor (~0.91) and reduced lattice strain; the precisely tuned precursor concentration (1.73 mol/L) ensures optimal supersaturation for nucleation density, while the two-step spin-coating (1000 rpm/10 s for wet-film formation followed by 5000 rpm/40 s for rapid solvent extraction) synergizes with the timed antisolvent quench—160 µL of chlorobenzene delivered 10 s before spin cessation—to induce instantaneous, homogeneous nucleation across the substrate, thereby minimizing stochastic grain boundary formation and suppressing PbI₂-rich amorphous intermediates that act as recombination sinks; subsequent thermal annealing at 110 °C for 25 min drives complete solvent evaporation and crystallographic ripening without inducing phase segregation or excessive volatilization of FA⁺, yielding large, oriented grains with low intragrain defect density and suppressed non-radiative recombination pathways—this structural and morphological fidelity is corroborated by the high VOC of 1.1232 V (indicating minimal interfacial and bulk trap-assisted recombination), the robust JSC of 24.572 mA/cm² (reflecting efficient charge extraction and minimal parasitic absorption or reflection losses), and the high FF of 77.5874% (signifying low series resistance and balanced electron/hole transport), culminating in a PCE of 21.4128%.
